title: Cinema Platform / Service details
description: One service at a time: gRPC traffic, errors and latency per method, Node.js runtime, logs and traces

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: gRPC requests handled. gateway-service and notification-service don't serve gRPC, so this stays 0 for them.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: INTERNAL, UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE... as a share of all requests

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the last start of the container

panels.title: Methods (selected time range)
panels.description: Non-OK includes expected codes like NOT_FOUND; server errors are only INTERNAL/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and similar

targets.expr: (sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method", status!="OK"}[$__range])) or sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method", status=~"INTERNAL|UNKNOWN|UNAVAILABLE|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|DATA_LOSS|UNIMPLEMENTED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[$__range])) or sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method) (increase(grpc_requests_total{service="$service", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Heap used growing without coming back down after GC = a memory leak

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: How long callbacks wait to run. Above ~100 ms something blocks the event loop.

panels.title: GC time by kind
panels.description: Share of time spent in garbage collection

panels.title: Active handles and requests
panels.description: Open sockets, timers, files. Steady growth means something isn't being closed.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Click a line and use the TraceID link to open its trace

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Latest traces that went through this service. Click a trace ID to open it.
